verdict.rationale: Decagon offers Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) to define agent behavior/policies in natural language and testing/QA (Simulations, Duet-generated tests) to verify agents 'respond accurately, follow policies' — these could constrain invented promises, but there is no explicit documentation of a safe-decline mechanism for off-knowledge questions or anti-hallucination guardrails. missing for 10: explicit anti-hallucination/knowledge-boundary guardrail documentation, evidence of 'safe decline' behavior for out-of-scope queries, independent validation that agents don't fabricate policies/prices.
